messages:
alex: Quick sync 1: tenant_meta add_col+backfill still set for tonight. Original quiet-slot 02:00 UTC. Resharding team just posted a maintenance at 01:45 that may overlap. Propose moving quiet-slot earlier to 01:15 and limit to 20m. Thoughts?

maya: 01:15 + 20m cap sounds safer to me. If reshard touches the same shards we should abort.

suresh: Agree on earlier slot. Rollback triggers well use: sustained p99 write > 350ms for >4m OR job error rate >3% for two consecutive waves OR backlog growth >12k rows => abort. Also: if backfill throughput doesn't hit 400 rows/s after first 6m, abort.

alex: I'll pin services to v2.14.7 for the migration and add the feature flag gating. jen, can you draft a short release note entry?

deploy-bot: Migration task scheduled: tenant_meta_add_col_backfill (id: 3421007654). Start: 2026-03-24T01:15:00Z. Plan: canary on 1 tenant, then waves of 4 tenants. Operators: @maya, @suresh.

jen: Drafted release note: "Add account_tier column to tenant_meta + concurrent index. Background backfill only. No user-facing change." Linked runbook: https://go/docs/migrations/tenant_meta_backfill_runbook

maya: Ops steps: if abort, flip `flags.tenant_meta_backfill=false` then `systemctl restart backfill-workers` to drain. DB relief: `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%tenant_meta%' AND state='active';`

suresh: SQL is online-friendly: `ALTER TABLE tenant_meta ADD COLUMN account_tier text;` then `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tenant_account_tier ON tenant_meta (account_tier);` Backfill writes are performed by worker service, no exclusive locks expected.

alex: Monitoring plan: p99 write latency, backfill row rate, and processing queue length. Canary policy: 1 failed canary = pause + manual go/no-go. If ETA > 90m abort.

deploy-bot: Canary started on tenant t-77 at 2026-03-24T01:15:12Z. Result: canary ok.

maya: Canary looks good infra-side. Launching wave 1/5 (4 tenants). Watching p99 and queue meters.

deploy-bot: Wave 1/5 started. Progressing; expected ~7m per wave.

alex: Noticed a p99 spike to ~365ms around 3421007680 (01:16:20). Checked infra alert - there was a short disk GC on replica causing IO pressure. If spike lasts >4m we abort.

maya: We'll keep an eye. If we need to halt mid-wave, flip flag and stop workers. Index is concurrent, DDL is durable so we won't roll back DDL changes, only stop further row writes.

jen: Pushed release note to #release-notes; tagged support and platform. Added post-deploy checklist to the migration doc.

deploy-bot: Waves 1-5 completed. Migration task 3421007654 finished for 20/20 tenants at 2026-03-24T01:22:05Z. Summary: no canary failures, no abort triggered.

alex: Great work. We'll monitor for 30m and close the window if stable. If any regressions surface open a rollback thread and follow the linked playbook.
